v1.0:

- First release.
- 835 things, 192 questions, streamed from a 96 KB table on the SD card.
- Bayesian belief updating with Gini-purity question selection; 20 questions, three
  guesses, then it asks you to teach it the word.
- Teach it new words: stored on the SD card and included in later games.
- Five-answer input (Yes / probably / don't know / probably not / No), undo by replay,
  progress bar, stats and settings.
